propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally pops reverse entries only when the forward entry carries a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when the forward entry lacks jira_key or has been removed
Stranded reverse index entries are never cleaned up by any public API surface, causing permanent binding-drift canary alerts and masking genuine future integrity problems
unbind() is safe today only by whole-file invariant (that reverse writes imply jira_key exists) not by its own logic, creating vulnerability to future code changes or merge artifacts
The fix makes unbind() self-contained by sweeping the reverse index for any residual key pointing at the local_id after the keyed pop, clearing stranded entries unconditionally
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair verb with four pre-write guards verifies orphan class and performs deletion via unbind() + save(), creating a supported prune surface for operators
